item.title: Cloud Industry Observations - 2017
item.description: 1. Classification of Cloud Services IaaS, which provides computing and storage services. PaaS, which provides the platform environment in which software runs. SaaS, which delivers software services directly. 2. Application Scenarios for Cloud Services Adopting cloud services can significantly reduce IT spending. Among IaaS services, cloud hosts and storage are the products with the highest adoption rates, followed by databases and network acceleration.
